definitions.gloss: large grain; large drop; large-sized (fruit, bead, etc.)
definitions.explanation: Describes something that comes in individual units (grains, drops, berries, etc.) that are notably large in size. Often used as a modifier with の.

examples.japanese: {大粒|おおつぶ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{涙|なみだ}→涙：02235_namida⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦こぼれた→こぼれる：02105_koboreru⟧。
{大粒|おおつぶ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{雨|あめ}→雨：00583_ame⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{降|ふ}り{始|はじ}めた→降り始める：22638_furihajimeru⟧。
examples.english: Large drops of rain started falling.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{品種|ひんしゅ}→品種：11840_hinshu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{大粒|おおつぶ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{苺|いちご}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{収穫|しゅうかく}→収穫：03207_shuukaku⟧⟦できる→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。

notes:
{大粒|おおつぶ} describes something that comes in individual units (drops, grains, berries) that are notably large. It is almost always used as a modifier with ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧.

FORMS:
{大|おお} (large) + ⟦{粒|つぶ}→粒：03892_tsubu⟧ (grain, drop, particle)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {大粒|おおつぶ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{涙|なみだ}→涙：02235_namida⟧: large teardrops
- {大粒|おおつぶ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{雨|あめ}→雨：00583_ame⟧: large raindrops
- {大粒|おおつぶ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{葡萄|ぶどう}: large grapes
- {大粒|おおつぶ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{苺|いちご}: large strawberries
- {大粒|おおつぶ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{真珠|しんじゅ}→真珠：19873_shinju⟧: large pearls

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{小粒|こつぶ}→小粒：16537_kotsubu⟧: small grain/drop (antonym)
- {粒|つぶ}ぞろい: uniformly excellent (figurative use of ⟦{粒|つぶ}→粒：03892_tsubu⟧)
